title: Hill Chart
empty.title: Put your first project on the hill
empty.body: Uphill is figuring out what the work really is. Over the top, the unknowns are gone and it's just doing. Type a name below and press Enter, or double-click the hill where it stands.
clearDone.tip: Take finished projects off the hill. They stay in the file.
file.problem: Not saving anything: the projects file can't be used (%1)
hint: drag dots · ←→ move · ↑↓ pick · n new · t label · c color · del remove · ctrl+z undo
labels.showAllTip: Show every label on the hill (Shift+T)
labels.hideAllTip: Hide every label on the hill (Shift+T)
hint.empty: type a name and press enter · or double-click the hill where the project stands
peek.empty: Nothing on the hill yet. Click to add a project.
